summary.key_theme: 市場高度關注 Apple 獨特的「輕資本」AI 策略及其即將公布的財報表現，投資人正評估其定價能力能否抵銷硬體成長放緩的壓力。

bullish.title: Apple’s anti-capex AI strategy pays off as shares lead the Mag7
bullish.reason: Apple 採取與其他科技巨頭不同的 AI 策略，透過整合外部模型與現有裝置網絡，成功避免了大規模資本支出，市場對此資本效率給予高度肯定。

bullish.title: Apple Hits Record Highs, Eyes Foldable Market Share, Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call and More
bullish.reason: 股價創下歷史新高反映市場樂觀情緒，且公司積極佈局摺疊手機市場，展現未來成長潛力。

bullish.title: Apple (AAPL) Readies Foldable iPhone As Samsung Launches New Rival Phones
bullish.reason: Apple 準備進入摺疊手機領域，這被視為維持硬體競爭力與擴大市佔率的關鍵舉措。

bullish.title: Ford Just Put Apple Maps in the Dashboard of a $30,000 EV
bullish.reason: Apple 成功將軟體生態系統整合至 Ford 車款，證明其在放棄造車計畫後，仍能透過軟體授權實現獲利。

bullish.title: Apple becomes the Mag7 hedge against hyperscaler spending
bullish.reason: 投資人將 Apple 視為對抗超大規模雲端運算支出過高的避險標的，凸顯其財務穩健性。

bearish.title: Tim Cook’s final Apple earnings report puts pricing power to the test
bearish.reason: 市場擔憂在硬體單位成長放緩的情況下，Apple 是否能持續透過提高服務與裝置價格來維持獲利成長。

bearish.title: Prediction: Alphabet Will Beat Apple to a $5 Trillion Market Cap
bearish.reason: 分析指出 Apple 的領先地位並不穩固，Alphabet 可能在市值成長上超越 Apple。

bearish.title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Tripled Berkshire's Stake in This Megacap AI Stock (Hint: Not Apple)
bearish.reason: Berkshire Hathaway 轉向加碼 Alphabet 而非 Apple，可能引發市場對 Apple 長期投資吸引力的疑慮。

neutral.title: 5 Earnings Reports to Watch as Big Tech’s AI Spending Faces a Test
neutral.reason: 將 Apple 列為本週財報觀察重點，屬於市場例行性報導，無特定多空傾向。

neutral.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Apple Leads Earnings Wave, Fed Meeting Ahead
neutral.reason: 報導重點在於總體經濟環境與財報週，Apple 僅被提及為市場焦點之一。

neutral.title: Needham's Laura Martin: Apple is 'betting the farm' it doesn't need its own AI model
neutral.reason: 分析師對 Apple 不開發自有 AI 模型的策略持保留態度，認為這是一場高風險的賭注。
